method: Microsoft GW-BASIC source build under FreeDOS/QEMU; real console input, numeric results saved by BASIC

20 CLS:PRINT "CASE-0"
30 X=RND(-1):RANDOMIZE
40 OPEN "R0.TXT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
50 PRINT #1,INT(RND(0)*1000000);INT(RND(1)*1000000)
60 CLOSE:PRINT "DONE-0":SYSTEM
900 OPEN "R0.TXT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1:PRINT #1,ERR;ERL:CLOSE:PRINT "DONE-0":SYSTEM

input_chars.source:
10 CLS:PRINT "READ0:";
20 A$=INPUT$(3)
30 OPEN "I0.TXT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
40 FOR I=1 TO LEN(A$):PRINT #1,ASC(MID$(A$,I,1));:NEXT I
60 PRINT #1,POS(0);CSRLIN:CLOSE #1:PRINT "DONE0":SYSTEM

10 CLS:PRINT "READ1:";
20 A$=INPUT$(2)
30 OPEN "I1.TXT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
40 FOR I=1 TO LEN(A$):PRINT #1,ASC(MID$(A$,I,1));:NEXT I
60 PRINT #1,POS(0);CSRLIN:CLOSE #1:PRINT "DONE1":SYSTEM
